scenes.description: The video starts with a view of a white countertop, with a sink located towards the left side. On top of the counter, there is a red container holding some green items along with several papers scattered around it. To the right of this setup, part of another piece of furniture can be seen. A hand then enters the frame from the bottom center, moving towards the right.

In this scene, a small section of a beige-colored wall becomes visible behind the red container on the countertop. Additionally, part of a brownish surface appears at the top of the frame. The hand re-enters from the bottom center and reaches toward the red container.
